title: Known-bit acoustic link dataset and code: error-budget decomposition of a real reverberant channel
description: SigMF recordings of a laptop speaker-to-microphone acoustic link (3 kHz carrier, BPSK-64QAM, 250-2000 baud) in which every transmitted bit is known, together with the receiver, the error-budget decomposition, impulse-response and equalizer-reach analysis code. See README.md, DATASET_README.md and PAPER.md.
